author: D Paxton
text:
Had a great experience with nick after suffering a mechanical failure on my modified TTRS.

After making a booking with a garage for the repairs, I set about looking for a recovery driver. We found multiple people who, due to the modified nature and low ride height of my car, either refused the job informed me that I would be liable for any damage they caused in loading and unloading, or in one instance, showed up to look at it and walked away.

In a bit of a panic I found Nick online. He answered the phone right away and informed me that he would be with me in 30 minutes. When I explained what had happened with the other guys he was not concerned and reassured me that he had faith in his equipment.

25 minutes later Nick was with us. He started off by explaining exactly how he planned to tackle the task, what he was going to use and how he was going to do it. This was especially reassuring based on all the worry that other people had created.

The car was loaded on his truck in around 10 minutes - no problems or issues! He used specialist race ramps to ensure there was no damage to my vehicle and that the car was properly and securely loaded with the upmost care. This was not a “hope for the best” scenario, he was fully equipped to do the job and with the experience and professionalism to match!

Nick wanted to collect some pictures and videos for his social media and advertising - he asked me if this was ok, to which I agreed. Whilst he didn’t need to do this, it was again nice that he was respectful enough to make sure I was ok with it.

My car was then delivered to the garage within the hour, I was provided with a message from Nick to update me along with pictures of the car safely at it’s destination.

Nick is a small independent operator and this shows in the best way possible - he is focused on the car and customer in hand, and not rushing things to get to the next job without any care (like the big guys in the industry). His prices are fair, he is polite and respectful to the customer, and most importantly he has the highest skill and equipment to get your car transported safely (especially as car is particularly awkward to deal with in these situations due to the excessively low and wide nature).

I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Nick to friends or family with similar cars, and can’t thank him enough for treating us so well. Please don’t take my word for it - Nick is the guy you need! Thanks for everything, and will definitely be in touch when I need a car transporting again!
